g.text: Makes one RuntimeContext per running app: appId, spec, services, Access
Modes, theme, data snapshot, formula cache. Swaps the spec on a live edit.
One map, one renderer per component type, checked against the schema. An
unknown type draws a quiet note and the rest of the screen keeps working.
Views for text, inputs, list, stat, chart, photo, timer and more. They hold
done if a later write fails.
and counters read from the data
records, state (key-value), runAIBlock, speak, pickImage, confirm,
online. Previews keep records in memory; saved apps use the local
Runtime engine: a validated spec becomes a working app
Source: src/runtime (KalamRuntime.tsx, registry.tsx, engine/*), src/core/formula, RuntimeServices in core/contracts
